outline:
本課程將訓練學生運用電腦2D與3D軟體進行視覺轉譯與創意提案。
課程強調實作與思考並重：學生將透過操作練習建立數位軟體能力，並透過研究方法與品牌策略的訓練，培養從構想到完整提案的敘事與轉譯能力。
This course trains students to use 2D and 3D computer software for visual translation and creative proposal development. The course emphasizes both hands-on practice and critical thinking: students will build digital software skills through practical exercises, while developing narrative and translation abilities—from concept to complete proposal—through training in research methods and brand strategy.
schedule:
Week 01 課程導論 | Course Introduction
Week 02 圖像美學歷史與發展1 | History and Development of Graphic Aesthetics I
Week 03 圖像美學歷史與發展2 | History and Development of Graphic Aesthetics II
Week 04 軟體實作與簡報練習 | Software Practice and Presentation Exercise
Week 05 電腦繪圖基礎 (向量繪圖基礎操作) | Computer Graphics Fundamentals
Week 06 簡報實作報告 | Presentation Practice & Report
Week 07 拼貼實作 | Collage Practice
Week 08 Logo初體驗 | Introduction to Logo Design
Week 08 創意工作坊1 (團隊組成／研究方法工作坊) | Creative Workshop 1
Week 09 創意工作坊2 (研究方法工作坊) | Creative Workshop 2
Week 10 商品研究與洞察整理 | Product Research and Insight Synthesis
Week 11 品牌價值與品牌故事 | Brand Values and Brand Storytelling
Week 12 情緒版與顏色思考 | Mood Boards and Color Thinking
Week 13 3D工具實作 | Introduction to 3D Tools
Week 14 空間與造型 | Spatial and Form Design
Week 15 期末提案工作坊 | Final Proposal Workshop
Week 16 期末發表：文化商品品牌提案 | Final Presentation: Cultural Product Branding Proposal

flexible_learning.content:
Week 17軟體工具整合實作
Flexible Learning: Integrated Software Production
學生利用彈性週，將課程所學之2D／3D軟體串聯運用，把團隊已完成之品牌視覺系統延伸應用於新的商品或素材產出，完整走過一次個人獨立操作的軟體整合流程。

Week 18彈性學習：軟體成果線上展示與同儕互評
Flexible Learning: Online Software Portfolio Showcase and Peer Review
學生於線上平臺展示個人軟體整合實作成果，透過跨組瀏覽與同儕互評，觀摩不同詮釋方式。
flexible_learning.outcome:
繳交專題成果作品以及學習心得。

學生於線上平臺展示個人軟體整合實作成果，透過跨組瀏覽與同儕互評，觀摩不同詮釋方式，為整體課程學習做一次非正式的統整與收尾。
